name: Reference Futures and FRED Fallback Test
description: Tests: 1) reference_futures transform, 2) common_reference_futures transform, 3) economic_indicators with forced use_alfred=True to verify ALFRED->FRED fallback.
source:
# Reference Futures and FRED Fallback Test

# Primary market data
src = market_data_source()()
spy_close = src.c

# ============================================================
# TEST 1: reference_futures (string ticker input)
# ============================================================
ref_es = reference_futures(ticker='ES')()
es_close = ref_es.c

# ============================================================
# TEST 2: common_reference_futures (select dropdown)
# ============================================================
ref_nq = common_reference_futures(ticker='NQ')()
nq_close = ref_nq.c

# ============================================================
# TEST 3: economic_indicators with FORCED use_alfred=True
# DCOILWTICO normally auto-detects to FRED mode.
# Forcing ALFRED should trigger fallback if needed.
# ============================================================
oil_data = economic_indicators(series_id='DCOILWTICO', use_alfred=True)()
oil_val = ffill(oil_data.result)

# ============================================================
# TEST 4: Normal ALFRED (CPI)
# ============================================================
cpi_data = economic_indicators(series_id='CPIAUCSL', use_alfred=True)()
cpi_val = ffill(cpi_data.result)

# ============================================================
# CHARTS
# ============================================================

timeseries_lines(
    title='SPY Close',
    category='1. Primary Asset',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.Blue)])
)(spy_close)

timeseries_lines(
    title='ES Futures (reference_futures)',
    category='2. Reference Futures',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='ES Close', color=Color.Green)])
)(es_close)

timeseries_lines(
    title='NQ Futures (common_reference_futures)',
    category='2. Reference Futures',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='NQ Close', color=Color.Orange)])
)(nq_close)

timeseries_lines(
    title='Crude Oil (DCOILWTICO, forced ALFRED)',
    category='3. FRED Fallback',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Crude Oil', color=Color.Red)])
)(oil_val)

timeseries_lines(
    title='CPI (CPIAUCSL, normal ALFRED)',
    category='3. FRED Fallback',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Purple)])
)(cpi_val)
